title: Your Portfolio Tracker Is Answering a Question You Never Asked
partialText: — A portfolio balance answers "what is it worth." It cannot answer "how did it get there," because nearly every tracker stores positions and throws away the events that produced them. That gap has three expensive consequences for anyone investing across borders: there are four different numbers called "return" and trackers show one, the tax that shapes your dividends is decided by a combination of countries that no dashboard models, and there are thresholds you cross with no event firing anywhere. This is what I found when I went looking, and what I built as a result.
